title: P3/P5 — Explicit reuse of reviewed outcome reports in next-work context
body:
## Goal and bounded authorization

Parent: P3 #1213; downstream continuity P5 #1215; coordination #1209. Selected under the user's standing request to inspect the repository, choose the next appropriate development point, and proceed with justified bounded work. This follows merged #1334/#1336/#1338 without reopening their accepted scopes.

Connect an already saved, attributed outcome report and its relevant expectation/result context to explicit source selection for the next ordinary work. The operator should not have to retype an existing correction, its conditions, and its source identity into a new note just to carry it forward.

One complete path: genuine A expectation and execution -> normal result review -> saved report R1 and explicit correction R2 -> explicitly select the reviewed historical material -> ordinary B comparison/preview/save -> fresh persisted read -> actual B consumer input. Preserve the distinction between a forecast, a host report, an operator observation, a typed assessment, a derived comparison, and an unresolved interpretation.

Authorize current-source diagnosis, the smallest justified implementation and development iteration, relevant contract/sequence updates, focused disposable/Browser verification, required final exact-head verification, and one Draft PR. This is a product connection, not an automatic-learning or usefulness study. No production installation/adoption, preparation/selection mutation, provider experiment, remote-transport revival, deployment, Ready, merge, or auto-merge.

## Inspected source and rationale

Observed main after #1338 merge: `460e1475b12c6392956df7dfdd7240114c9b6376`, tree `d791758d42f27143bf888037679fdabcac40aa7f`, identical to reviewed #1338 head `8b57cd8f8a16b4e4d26b53d57285b6dac8b2a882`. Recheck then-current main; this is provenance, not a forced future base.

- `lib/vnext/runtime/authored-successor-task.ts`, `readResultWorkPreparationV01`, currently offers a `result_source` built from receipt status and the host's result-summary prose. Its preparation binding covers the packet, receipt, selection and root, not a later operator-report revision.
- `components/workbench/result-review/result-work-composer.tsx` passes that host-report source to the existing note-selection composer. Existing free-form notes can already express corrections; this task is not claiming that manual reuse is impossible.
- `components/workbench/semantic-review/work-expectation.tsx`, `WorkExpectationResult`, displays the saved expectation, comparison, operator reports and corrections and permits another explicit report. The inspected normal path does not supply those saved reports as selectable next-work source material.
- `lib/intake/selected-work-source-comparison.ts` already owns attributed source excerpts, exact content identities, explicit selection/omission and the 8-entry / 2,000-character / 12,000-serialized-byte budgets. Reuse it and the existing expectation/result readers and successor writer.
- Current 01/03/04 and P3 distinguish preserved historical experience, its delivery, actual later use, and demonstrated usefulness. This slice connects existing producers and consumers rather than creating another judgment engine.

This is an approved narrower-transcription capability, not a claimed production incident or a demand for new user-supplied failure evidence. Confirm the complete normal route in current source/disposable state. An existing equivalent connection is a valid evidence-backed no-change outcome.

## Required product behavior

1. From the normal completed-result flow, expose a bounded, explicitly selectable representation of the saved report/correction and the context necessary to understand it. Prefer the latest applicable report for the exact expectation/attempt/receipt relation; identify its recorded version and the fact that earlier reports remain historical. Do not silently choose an obsolete report as current. Reuse existing controls rather than adding a separate memory screen.
2. Reuse recorded text and deterministic labels. Do not have a model invent a lesson or automatically convert an observation into a general policy. Preserve the exact original requirement, relevant applicability conditions, reported observation/outcome, assessment or attestation basis, uncertainty, source identities and recorded times. A reported correction establishes what the operator said, not independently verified truth. A prediction match is not task success; unknown applicability/outcomes remain unknown.
3. Historical material is unselected by default. The operator explicitly chooses what B receives. No bulk carry-forward, inferred consent, new prospective expectation for B, backdating, or automatic worker delivery to A. Any exposure of A's historical forecast to B occurs only through this explicit, visible selection and remains labeled historical. B's own optional forecast remains separate and operator-only under #1338.
4. Bind generated reuse material to the exact validated saved source version and literal selected content, not an arbitrary client claim or locator string treated as proof. If the selected latest-report snapshot changes between preparation/preview and save, refuse stale reuse without partial writes or silent replacement and allow ordinary refresh/review. Reuse existing authenticated/currentness/atomic-save owners. Do not make unrelated optional report changes a universal block when no report material is selected.
5. After B is saved, later R3 must not rewrite B's selected R2 snapshot or any original report. Keep it truthfully historical; further changes use an explicit supported B revision while eligible. This is snapshot reuse, not a subscription, global invalidation system or automatic propagation service.
6. Optional report absence, unavailable comparison, unsupported local chronology or budget overflow must have an honest local disposition. They must not break an otherwise eligible ordinary preparation without this material. Do not invent local execution/chronology for imported records. Do not silently clip source text, omit qualifiers, increase budgets or force all prior material into B. Use a small coherent grouping within existing limits, or explicitly report that exact reuse does not fit and retain the existing attributed-note path. Editing generated text must remain recognizable as a newly authored note, not the unchanged saved report.

## Implementation boundary

Use the existing expectation store and readers, result-review/composer, source-selection, preparation/revision writer and fresh consumer owners. A narrow additive request/projection/provenance profile is allowed if needed, with explicit compatibility validation. Historical first-work, ordinary-successor, scoped/revalidation, source-read, forecast binding and result semantics retain their existing meanings.

No new Core kind, table/store/migration, memory engine, graph, learned selector, scheduler, recall framework, generalized cross-project access, remote write surface, or automatic semantic/decision/execution authority. Do not broaden retry, failure/expiry succession, task-switching or history activation merely to simplify this connection. No blanket documentation reconciliation or verification-optimization project.

## Discriminating evidence

Use supported disposable state and real writers/readers. Produce the eligible predecessor through the existing deterministic host; create/report/correct expectations through normal owners. Do not manufacture production receipts or accepted-state records.

Demonstrate the before/after operator path, including removal of retyping for already recorded material. Verify:
- R1 -> R2 with different outcomes/conditions/uncertainty; selecting R2 retains attribution and original history, while no selection delivers none of this optional material.
- Exact preview/save/reopen and native source reading; actual deterministic B input contains only the explicitly selected historical material and no B forecast or unselected report text.
- Stale R2 -> R3 during preparation, forged/foreign source bindings, malformed/unsupported optional data, budgets, execution races, competing saves, rollback and exact write effects.
- R3 after B save leaves B's R2 snapshot unchanged; an eligible explicit B revision can replace/remove selected material through existing owners.
- Existing absence/manual-note/host-report workflows and relevant import/restore compatibility remain usable. Unknown chronology never becomes a new prospective or verification claim.
- Real Browser report/correction -> selection -> preview/save -> fresh readback, not helper-only or unsaved-composer evidence.

Reuse existing covered lifecycle/refusal cases rather than rerunning completed P3/P5 research. Measure observable composition/copy/review steps where practical, with setup and verification costs separated. Do not infer better judgment, reduced human effort or autonomous learning from fixture success or fewer controls.

## Local execution and completion

Read current AGENTS and relevant 01/02/03/04. Verify `/Users/hynk/code/augnes`, origin `https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes.git`, branch, HEAD, current main and worktree. Safely fetch/update refs and create a new issue-specific branch from then-current main; do not commit on merged #1337's branch or overwrite unrelated work.

Preserve the existing unexecuted P2 production preparation and its notes. Prior successful native reads and missing full loaded-build identity do not establish a runtime defect or justify another adoption/readiness investigation. Deferred remote transport and held/consumed studies remain unchanged.

Codex owns current-source methods/files and may reject unsupported ChatGPT hypotheses, choose a simpler implementation, or establish no change is needed. Complete justified focused iteration before final exact-clean-head planner-required verification. Prior #1334/#1336/#1338 receipts remain historical; no cross-head transfer or retry of an unchanged failed deciding head for green. Follow current lifecycle/resource/cleanup owners.

Open one Draft PR with source identities, observed baseline, changed responsibility, user-visible and actual-consumer evidence, compatibility/authority impact, verification, cleanup, remaining unknowns, and a concrete next decision. Stop at review; do not automatically launch another capability extension or study. This issue registration changes planning only: no local source, runtime or canonical project state has been modified.
